overallPassInference.reason: Only the written partial result can be reported. The official pass condition requires 60 % in the written AND 60 % in the oral part; because the pilot does not assess speaking, no overall pass, fail or grade band may be computed or shown.

answerRules.rule: Each option (headline in Teil 1, advertisement in Teil 3) may be used only once.
If no advertisement matches a situation, the learner marks an x. Stated for Leseverstehen Teil 3 only; it is not stated for Teil 1 or Teil 2.
Each word from the option list a-o fits only once.
Mark PLUS (+) for richtig and MINUS (-) for falsch on the answer sheet.
Permitted plays are not uniform: one play in Teil 1, two plays in Teil 2, and two plays for each of the five short texts in Teil 3.
The three criterion scores are summed (max 15) and multiplied by three in the publisher's centre, giving a subtest maximum of 45 points.

If the text has no or hardly any connection to the writing task, D is given for all three criteria and the Thema-verfehlt field is marked. If only the situational framing is missed, or only one or no Leitpunkt is handled appropriately, only Kriterium I is set to D and criteria II and III are still assessed.

unresolved.question: The general binding regulations are now located and verified (S3, gültig ab 15.04.2025), but no test specification or Prüfungsordnung specific to the classic Zertifikat Deutsch B1 was found, so the written-format rules still rest on the model test (S2) plus the exam page (S1).

Whether the 13. Auflage 2020 model test is still the current one for the classic B1 exam. A different, newer scaled examination (telc Deutsch A2·B1) was verified, and S3 requires model tests to be used in their current version.

Whether wrong objective answers are penalised or guessing is discouraged. No such provision exists in the model test instructions or in the binding regulations (S3); the absence of a rule is not itself a rule, so this stays unresolved rather than inferred from silence.
What the learner should do when no option fits in Sprachbausteine Teil 1 or Leseverstehen Teil 2; the no-match rule is printed only for Leseverstehen Teil 3.
There is no printed sub-allocation of the shared 90 minutes between Leseverstehen and Sprachbausteine.
No per-part duration is printed for Hörverstehen beyond the announced reading pauses; the section is given as approximately 30 minutes.

How or whether fractional written totals arise for the printed grade bands, whose endpoints include .5. All verified point-bearing elements are integral, so a .5 total is arithmetically unreachable and the endpoints act as strict upper limits; no rounding rule exists in the model test or the regulations.

The precise differences from Deutsch-Test für den Beruf, telc Deutsch B1·B2 Beruf, telc Deutsch B1 Schule and DTZ were not examined systematically. The scaled telc Deutsch A2·B1 is now distinguished from the classic B1 using verified evidence.
